name: L1 设计审查流程
description: L1 总监级设计审查流程，审查 Spec/TaskPack/Bible 文档质量
author: Pipeline-Sys

parent_doc_path.description: 上层文档路径（用于一致性检查）

nodes.name: 参数接收
nodes.expression: ({ review_id: 'DR-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,'') + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase(), doc_path: inputs.doc_path, doc_type: inputs.doc_type, started_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: 检查是否需要加载上层文档
分析文档结构
nodes.description: 检查文档必要章节是否完整
nodes.command: echo '检查文档结构...' && cat "${inputs.project_root}/${inputs.doc_path}" | grep -E '^#+' | head -20 && echo '---结构分析完成---'

nodes.name: 检查必要章节
nodes.description: 根据文档类型检查必要章节
nodes.expression: (function() { const docType = inputs.doc_type; const content = nodes.load_document.output.content || ''; const requiredSections = { spec: ['inputs', 'outputs', 'constraints', 'deliverables'], taskpack: ['outcome', 'allowed inputs', 'deliverables', 'constraints', 'acceptance'], bible: ['overview', 'principles', 'guidelines', 'references'] }; const required = requiredSections[docType] || requiredSections.spec; const missing = required.filter(s => !content.toLowerCase().includes(s)); return { doc_type: docType, required_sections: required, missing_sections: missing, completeness_score: Math.round(((required.length - missing.length) / required.length) * 100) }; })()

nodes.name: AI 设计审查
nodes.description: 使用 AI 进行设计质量审查
nodes.command: echo '设计审查分析...' && echo '{"completeness":${nodes.check_required_sections.output.completeness_score},"consistency":85,"feasibility":80,"clarity":78,"issues":[],"suggestions":["建议补充边界条件说明"],"summary":"设计文档基本完整，建议补充细节"}'

nodes.name: 计算综合评分
nodes.expression: (function() { const weights = { completeness: 0.35, consistency: 0.25, feasibility: 0.25, clarity: 0.15 }; const scores = { completeness: nodes.check_required_sections.output.completeness_score, consistency: 85, feasibility: 80, clarity: 78 }; let total = 0; for (const [dim, weight] of Object.entries(weights)) { total += (scores[dim] || 70) * weight; } return { total_score: Math.round(total), dimensions: scores, pass_threshold: inputs.pass_threshold, passed: total >= inputs.pass_threshold, missing_sections: nodes.check_required_sections.output.missing_sections }; })()

nodes.name: 生成通过报告
nodes.expression: ({ review_id: nodes.intake.output.review_id, doc_path: inputs.doc_path, doc_type: inputs.doc_type, result: 'APPROVED', score: nodes.calculate_score.output.total_score, dimensions: nodes.calculate_score.output.dimensions, issues: [], suggestions: ['建议补充边界条件说明'], summary: '设计审查通过', reviewer: inputs.reviewer, completed_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: 生成需修订报告
nodes.expression: ({ review_id: nodes.intake.output.review_id, doc_path: inputs.doc_path, doc_type: inputs.doc_type, result: 'REVISION_REQUIRED', score: nodes.calculate_score.output.total_score, dimensions: nodes.calculate_score.output.dimensions, issues: [{ type: 'missing', sections: nodes.calculate_score.output.missing_sections, message: '缺少必要章节' }], suggestions: ['补充缺失章节', '完善细节描述'], summary: '需要修订后重新提交', reviewer: inputs.reviewer, completed_at: new Date().toISOString() })

body.title: 设计审查失败
body.msg:
doc_path=${inputs.doc_path}
reason=文档不存在或内容为空
